request:
镜头 s29：纪录片空镜，时长 7 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：raw verite documentary footage shot handheld in 2075 on a high-ISO full-frame documentary camera in available light only: visible sensor noise, deep solid blacks, volumetric haze and silhouettes, true-to-life skin tones, focus occasionally hunting
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary establishing shot on a long zoom lens, atmospheric haze
导演意图（自然语言）：长焦大远景，几乎固定，风雪掠过。木星占满了整个天空，冰原被染成暗橙色，远处一台熄火的发动机。环境声：低沉的风声、冰层的呻吟。
情绪：overwhelming, dreadful, silent
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：extreme wide shot on a long lens, locked-off with snow blowing across
景深与虚实：Deep focus, snow in the foreground streaked with motion blur.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Exterior wide shot from the frozen surface of the Earth looking up: the planet Jupiter fills almost the entire sky, its bands and the Great Red Spot terrifyingly close, staining the ice plain dull orange; silhouettes of a stalled planetary engine and a tiny transport truck on the horizon. Blocking lock: Jupiter fills the upper two thirds of the frame; the ice plain lies across the bottom; the stalled engine silhouette at frame right on the horizon.
Picture 2: the ice plain under a sky filled by Jupiter (location reference; role: location reference). Exterior wide shot from the frozen surface of the Earth looking up: the planet Jupiter fills almost the entire sky, its bands and the Great Red Spot terrifyingly close, staining the ice plain dull orange; a faint stream of atmosphere is being pulled from the Earth towards it; silhouettes of a stalled planetary engine and a tiny transport truck on the horizon.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：low howling wind, deep groaning of ice
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

Exterior wide view from the frozen surface of the Earth looking up: Jupiter fills almost the entire sky, its bands and the Great Red Spot terrifyingly close, staining the ice plain dull orange; a faint stream of atmosphere is being pulled from the Earth towards it; silhouettes of a stalled planetary engine and a tiny transport truck on the horizon. Layout: flat broken ice sheet running to a low horizon line, the sky occupied almost entirely by the planet above. detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 7.0s, 24fps, raw verite documentary footage shot handheld in 2075 on a high-ISO full-frame documentary camera in available light only: visible sensor noise, deep solid blacks, volumetric haze and silhouettes, true-to-life skin tones, focus occasionally hunting; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, extreme wide shot on a long zoom lens, locked-off and essentially static for the whole take, with only the faintest wind tremor in the frame; pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Jupiter fills the upper two thirds of the frame, the ice plain lies across the bottom, the stalled planetary engine silhouette at frame right on the horizon with the tiny transport truck beside it, blown snow streaking through the foreground from frame left to frame right. Start: the frame holds on the still plain, the orange banded face of Jupiter overhead, the haze layers hanging between the ice and the planet. Middle: a low gust drives a sheet of surface snow across the foreground from frame left to frame right, briefly veiling the horizon, while above the plain a faint stream of atmosphere lifts thinly upward toward the planet's face; the focus breathes off the far horizon and hunts back onto the engine silhouette. End: the snow settles into a slow drift, the atmosphere stream thins to a thread, and the frame comes to rest with the ice plain and the black engine silhouette unchanged at frame right, the planet pressing down on the sky. Mood: overwhelming, dreadful, silent. Blur: deep focus, the ice crust and the engine silhouette both readable, only the foreground snow streaked into motion blur and the highest haze layers soft; slight grain and sensor noise across the deep blacks. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.

overall_soundscape:
Low howling wind across open ice, the deep groaning of the ice sheet shifting, dry snow hissing over the crust and past the camera, a thin high whistle at the edges of the wind, one distant metallic creak from the stalled engine structure; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.
